references.text: The priest shall examine the wound and declare the person unclean if the hair has turned white and the wound appears deeper than the skin - the same criteria as in verse 20
A parallel situation where the priest examines a burn with the same signs: white hair and a wound that is deeper than the skin, leading to a declaration of leprosy
Describes the priest's examination of a skin disease and the procedure for declaring a person unclean or clean
Describes the priest's role in examining the healed leper - the opposite process of the uncleanness diagnosis in 13:20
The context of verse 20: describes the boil that has healed and left a white or reddish mark that the priest must examine
Moses reminds the Israelites to carefully follow the priests' instructions regarding leprosy
